segments.text: Lesson 48
segments.translation: 第48课

segments.text: The silent village
segments.translation: 沉寂的村庄

segments.text: Listen to the tape then answer this question.
segments.translation: 听录音，然后回答问题。

segments.text: Why was the village silent?
segments.translation: 为什么村庄是沉寂的？

segments.text: In this much-travelled world, there are still thousands of places which are inaccessible to tourists.
segments.translation: 在这个旅游业发达的世界里，仍有成千上万个游客无法到达的地方。

segments.text: We always assume that villagers in remote places are friendly and hospitable.
segments.translation: 我们总是认为偏远地区的人们是友好且好客的。

segments.text: But people who are cut off not only from foreign tourists, but even from their own countrymen can be hostile to travellers.
segments.translation: 但那些不仅与外国游客隔绝，甚至与本国同胞也隔绝的人们，可能对旅行者怀有敌意。

segments.text: Visits to really remote villages are seldom enjoyable--as my wife and I discovered during a tour through the Balkans.
segments.translation: 去真正偏远的村庄旅行很少是愉快的——正如我妻子和我，在一次穿越巴尔干半岛的旅行中发现的那样。

segments.text: We had spent several days in a small town and visited a number of old churches in the vicinity.
segments.translation: 我们在一个小镇住了几天，参观了附近的许多古老教堂。

segments.text: These attracted many visitors, for they were not only of great architectural interest, but contained a large number of beautifully preserved frescoes as well.
segments.translation: 这些教堂吸引了许多游客，因为它们不仅具有极大的建筑研究价值，而且还包含大量保存完好的壁画。

segments.text: On the day before our departure, several bus loads of tourists descended on the town.
segments.translation: 在我们出发的前一天，好几辆公车的游客突然降临到这个小镇。

segments.text: This was more than we could bear, so we decided to spend our last day exploring the countryside.
segments.translation: 这超出了我们的承受能力，所以我们决定利用最后一天去勘探农村地区。

segments.text: Taking a path which led out of the town, we crossed a few fields until we came to a dense wood.
segments.translation: 沿着一条通往镇外的小路，我们穿过几块田地，直到来到一片茂密的树林。

segments.text: We expected the path to end abruptly, but we found that it traced its way through the trees.
segments.translation: 我们原以为小路会突然中断，但我们发现它在树丛中穿行。

segments.text: We tramped through the wood for over two hours until we arrived at a deep stream.
segments.translation: 我们在林中跋涉了两个多小时，直到来到一条深溪边。

segments.text: We could see that the path continued on the other side, but we had no idea how we could get across the stream.
segments.translation: 我们可以看到小路在对岸继续延伸，但我们不知道该如何过溪。

segments.text: Suddenly my wife spotted a boat moored to the bank.
segments.translation: 突然间，我妻子发现在岸边停泊着一只船。

segments.text: In it there was a boatman fast asleep.
segments.translation: 船里有一个船夫正在熟睡。

segments.text: We gently woke him up and asked him to ferry us to the other side.
segments.translation: 我们轻轻地摇醒了他，请他把我们渡到对岸。

segments.text: Though he was reluctant to do so at first, we eventually persuaded him to take us.
segments.translation: 虽然起初他不情愿这样做，但我们最终说服了他带我们过去。

segments.text: The path led to a tiny village perched on the steep sides of a mountain.
segments.translation: 小路通向一个坐落在陡峭山坡上的小村庄。

segments.text: The place consisted of a straggling unmade road which was lined on either side by small houses.
segments.translation: 那个地方由一条坎坷不平、没有修筑过的路组成，路的兩旁排列着一间间小房子。

segments.text: Even under a clear blue sky, the village looked forbidding, as all the houses were built of grey mud bricks.
segments.translation: 即使在晴朗的蓝天下，村庄看起来也令人心惊胆战，因为所有的房子都是用灰色的泥砖盖成的。

segments.text: The village seemed deserted,
segments.translation: 村子似乎已经荒废了，

segments.text: the only sign of life being an ugly-looking black goat on a short length of rope tied to a tree in a field nearby.
segments.translation: 唯一的生命迹象是附近田里一棵树上系着一只样子难看的黑山羊。

segments.text: Sitting down on a dilapidated wooden fence near the field, we opened a couple of tins of sardines and had a picnic lunch.
segments.translation: 我们坐在田边破旧的木篱笆上，打开两罐沙丁鱼，吃了一顿野餐式的午餐。

segments.text: All at once, I noticed that my wife seemed to be filled with alarm.
segments.translation: 突然间，我注意到我妻子似乎充满了恐慌。

segments.text: Looking up I saw that we were surrounded by children in rags who were looking at us silently as we ate.
segments.translation: 抬头一看，我发现我们被一群衣衫褴褛的孩子包围了，他们正在我们吃饭时静静地注视着我们。

segments.text: We offered them food and spoke to them kindly, but they remained motionless.
segments.translation: 我们给他们食物，亲切地跟他们说话，但他们一动也不动。

segments.text: I concluded that they were simply shy of strangers.
segments.translation: 我断定他们只是怕生。

segments.text: When we later walked down the main street of the village, we were followed by a silent procession of children.
segments.translation: 当我们后来走上村里的主干道时，一群沉默的孩子跟在了我们后面。

segments.text: The village which had seemed deserted, immediately came to life.
segments.translation: 原本似乎荒凉的村庄，立刻变得生机勃勃。

segments.text: Faces appeared at windows.
segments.translation: 窗户后面出现了一张张脸。

segments.text: Men in shirt sleeves stood outside their houses and glared at us.
segments.translation: 穿着衬衫的男人们站在屋子外面，怒气冲冲地盯着我们。

segments.text: Old women in black shawls peered at us from doorways.
segments.translation: 围着黑色披肩的老妇人们从门口窥视着我们。

segments.text: The most frightening thing of all was that not a sound could be heard.
segments.translation: 最可怕的是，连一点声音都听不到。

segments.text: There was no doubt that we were unwelcome visitors.
segments.translation: 毫无疑问，我们是不受欢迎的游客。

segments.text: We needed no further warning.
segments.translation: 我们不需要进一步的警告。

segments.text: Turning back down the main street, we quickened our pace and made our way rapidly towards the stream where we hoped the boatman was waiting.
segments.translation: 转过主街向回走，我们加快了脚步，迅速朝小溪走去，希望那名船夫正在那里等候。
